title: Measurement-source hierarchy: the day-shift totalizer is unavailable, a redundant meter at the same boundary stands in with a substitution flag; packing records stand in only with the silo stock change and lag accounted for; a 200 t forecast is never actual production
spec_ref: SME E7 (calendars and measurement-source hierarchy), SRC01, ACT05, D05

inputs.slice: day shift 06:00-14:00 UTC, one HDPE product, unit t, coverage gate 1
inputs.hierarchy: boundary reactor_outlet; 1 calibrated primary totalizer FT-101 (pi_counter), 2 redundant meter FT-102 (pi_counter, same boundary), 3 reconciled packing record (external_report, boundary packing, silo S-1 stock change accounted, lag 7200 s), 4 approved estimate (manual)
inputs.redundantMeter: FT-101 has no readings in the shift; FT-102 measures 200 t over the whole shift
inputs.packing: FT-101 and FT-102 have no readings; packing record 190 t bagged + 10 t silo S-1 stock increase = 200 t at the reactor boundary
inputs.forecast: plan / forecast 200 t for the shift; no measurement and no approved estimate
inputs.approvedEstimate: no measurement; an approved estimated gross adjustment of 195 t (shift supervisor log, approved by the production accountant)
